text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After school.
Fenomeno, a member of the disciplinary committee,
was taking part in a certain event.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Next up! When running on the road,
always follow the direction of the arrows
marked in the Umamusume-only lane!

text_block_list.name: Freshman Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Okaay.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: A-B-S-O-L-U-T-E-L-Y, s-i-r-r-r!

text_block_list.name: Freshman Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Running the wrong way causes accidents!
It is strictly prohibited! Do you copy, soldier?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The annual 'Umamusume Traffic Rules' orientation,
hosted by the Public Morals Committee.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Apparently, she gave another thorough, hour-long lecture to the new students this year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "CASE: Traffic Enforcement"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is my day off. While taking a stroll
around the neighborhood to refresh myself—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: You there, halt!

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaah!?
Y-Yes...?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"‘When walking,
stay out of the Umamusume-only lanes and walk on the sidewalk.’
I believe that is what I taught you."

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah, whoa...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Let us talk.
—Come with me.

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm so sorry!
I'm so, so sooooory!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
!? Hey!
Sudden acceleration puts a strain on your legs—!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, the light is flashing...!
Crossing now is out of the question, huh...?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
!
...Boss.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Actually, road accidents involving Umamusume
tend to increase around this time of year.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, this officer was on patrol,
keeping a watchful eye out for traffic violators!
choice_data_list: I see, patrolling on Disciplinary Committee duty...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no.
This patrol is a personal activity of mine.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even with orientation, some Umamusume
still struggle to memorize all the rules.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I am standing guard right here
and giving direct instruction myself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's his day off,
Fenomeno is at the service of the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that determination of hers,
I felt as though I couldn't just leave her on her own...
choice_data_list: Meno, mind if I help too?
Meno, is it okay if I help too?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —! ...Nnnngh, Boss...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You truly are a person with a selfless heart!!
Let us protect everyone's safety together!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Here, have some of this too!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's wave them together!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes, the light has turned green!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: You may cross now! If you're turning right, make sure to do a two-stage right turn!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You there! Halt!
You haven't switched to asphalt horseshoes, have you?!
choice_data_list: Could you let me see the soles of your shoes for a second?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Pigtails
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! 
Oh no, I'm gonna be late for our meet-up...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ngh! This smell—!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Pigtails
text_block_list.text:
Pardon meee!
Coming through~~! Turning corner~!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Y-You caaaan't!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Pigtails
text_block_list.text: Wah, whoa-whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"When there's a stop sign,
you must come to a complete stop even if the light is green!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Repeat after me!!
"When there's a stop sign,
you must stop even on a green light"!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Pigtails
text_block_list.text: Rule o-one: "When there is a stop sign, come to a complete stop even if the light is green"...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That is the absolute most basic rule of the Umamusume lanes!
Rules are not to be broken!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Kindly reconsider your perception.
This officer is watching you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Pigtails
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah~...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Good work out there! Boss!!
choice_data_list: Good work out there too, Meno

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
I should be the one thanking you for your cooperation, Boss!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Zero accidents and zero injuries today.
I truly pray that tomorrow will be just as peaceful!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I hope everyone stays safe

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I would like to continue
with these activities going forward.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Justice is about correcting wrongs and evil,
and guiding people onto the pure and righteous path!
choice_data_list: I'll join you again when that time comes.
I'll tag along with you again then.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ! Boss...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Truly, you are a person of noble justice.
Always thinking of the Umamusume's future...!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Let us protect them, always!
Shielding our children and Umamusume from an ill-fated future!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It's all to protect everyone.
To help everyone walk the right path!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it.
Accidents at that intersection have really dropped, haven't they~?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Right? Around this time two years ago was awful, though.
I'm so glad fewer Umamusume are getting injured now!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Right!
...Though, I was just talking
about that with my trainee~

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...She gave me this really disgusted look.
It seems my girl really hates that place."

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Same here!
Whenever we move, it's always 'Stay away!' and acting all stubborn, completely refusing to listen."

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: "Apparently they feel like they're being watched all the time and it's creeping them out."
